about: Routes the recipe export does not carry: stations whose recipes are code, not recipe files or export records (the crucible furnace's pot recipes, CrucibleFurnace/Core/PotRecipes.cs). Each is one batch: 'slots' are the ingredients (each a list of alternatives [code, items]; 'kept': true for a tool or station part not consumed), 'output' is [code, items], 'byproducts' are [code, expected items] credited at their value, 'kind' a markups.json kind, 'switch' the seraphhorizons config switch that owns it. A route is priced exactly as a recipe of the export (README.md, Rules); a route whose output the export lacks prices nothing. A new station that adds no export record adds its routes here, with its switch; a better home for any of them is an export record (tools/recipe-export), which also shows it in the recipe browser.
